messages:
Nora: Quick creative ask for next week's inbound campaign. Need a benchmark one-pager focused on inference economics with modular slices designers can drop into landing pages. Requirements: A4 print + responsive web slices (640, 960, 1200 widths), layered Figma file, and copy blocks for 'hero stat', 'how it works', and 'why it matters'.
Ethan: I'll provide the hero stat and the runbook blurb. ETA Tue. What voice? Short and punchy or more explanatory?
Maya: Prefer punchy for hero, then an explanatory 3-bullet section. Also include a compact table with cost-per-1000-tokens for 3 model configs.
Nora: Legal: add footnote: "Indexed on internal workloads, 2025". Also include a privacy blurb for gated assets.
ops-bot: CI reminder: export naming convention: bench_onepager_v1_A4.pdf, bench_onepager_v1_web_640.png etc. Auto-handoff to marketing-bucket on export.
design: Will start wireframe today. Any brand lockups for partner co-branding?
Nora: Not this round. Keep to Redwood-only. Also include an editable logo slot for future co-branding.
Ethan: Adding sample CSV: drive.redwood/bench/pack_stats.csv
Maya: Schedule review Wed 9am. I'll annex translations later.
Nora: Thanks team.
